text: Childminder here, I have a 4 yr old girl with me tonight whose eczema is realy flaring, dry scaly patches on her arms and behind her knees and she wont stop scratching. Parents asked me to check. I did the glass test on the patches and they go pale under it, theres no other spots anywere. No fits or shaking or anything like that. Do I just put her usual cream on and leave it till morning or does someone need to see her? Just need a yes or no really
